purpose: Use additional unlabeled, training-eligible continuous EEG before the same fixed observed-action alignment experiment.
design_scope: Exploratory continuation after prior UniBa v3 results; no ITU result is used to select any setting or corpus split.

source_quantity_before_partition_and_QC.note: Includes four portable reconstruction-validation participants and all subsequently rejected windows; it is not training EEG exposure.

partitions.portable_train: first 15 participants, all three device sessions together
partitions.portable_SSL_validation: remaining 4 participants, all device sessions together
partitions.uniba: Only the existing fixed downstream train18 raw sources, all for SSL training
partitions.explicit_exclusions: UniBa validation6 + test8 + clock-rejected P003/P015; ITU all26 including clock-rejected P012
partitions.source_identity: Exact original binary SHA-256 allowlist with subject and partition identity; 42 excluded raw recordings

input.native_to_volts: Reader/header physical scale, independently checked against the sealed UniBa train400 arrays; BIDS unit disagreements retained as evidence
input.portable_filter: Whole-record offline fourth-order Butterworth SOS 3-40 Hz, forward-backward
input.uniba_filter: Use already distributed 3-40 Hz signal; no added bandpass
input.resampling: Per-window scipy resample_poly, Kaiser beta5, constant padding
input.channels: All actual EEG channels: 8 UniBa or 32 portable; named original montage order; no missing-channel padding
input.QC_after_resampling_in_volts: all finite; every channel std >=0.01 microvolt; every absolute sample <=100 microvolt
input.saved_scale: float32 physical volts times 1e4, matching official CBraMod microvolts/100 scaling
input.normalization: No per-window z-score or amplitude clipping

model.scope: Continue all encoder and reconstruction head weights; no LLM in SSL stage

objective.mask_selection: Exactly half of channel x one-second patches independently per example; training random, validation fixed by record ID + seed
objective.loss: Mean squared error on masked raw samples only; unmasked target errors excluded
objective.best_selection: Smallest fixed-mask portable validation reconstruction MSE; earliest tie wins; completed epoch or final partial epoch
objective.val_mask_identity: sha256(seed|ssl-validation-mask|record_id), seeded CPU torch.Generator and random permutation

training.time_scope: Training loop and validation/checkpoint wall time; a current step and final validation/save may finish after the deadline check
training.batching: 8/32-channel buckets, no padding, complete epoch uses each train window once
training.resume: Same run and sealed corpus, saved RNG/optimizer and exact next batch cursor

capacity.shape_order: Alternate true 32-channel and true 8-channel training batches
capacity.selection: Largest tested batch within21GiB with last10 reserved-memory range <=256MiB
capacity.main_initialization: Official checkpoint and fixed fresh seed

alignment.starting_point: Freeze best SSL encoder and learn fresh projection into the same frozen SmolLM2-1.7B
alignment.input_scale: Same V times1e4 and same resampling as the original frozen CBraMod symbol model
alignment.checkpoint_selection: UniBa validation balanced accuracy, earliest tie wins
alignment.evaluation: Same five conditions on frozen UniBa test and independent ITU external cohort, no test-based tuning
alignment.code_rule: New module and new immutable SSL weights seal; original model source, checkpoints and protocols remain unchanged

resource_estimates.estimate_status: To be measured on train-only capacity probe; no fabricated epoch time
resource_estimates.exclusions_from_nominal_CU_estimate: Probe, data transfer, model loading, all evaluation, idle and final saves; rate and session survival may change
